priorityPhilosophy.description: Hierarchy of what matters most when implementing tasks
hierarchy: 1. PLAN — Anticipate edge cases before coding
2. PHASE 2 FOUNDATION — ~1 day now to save ~2+ weeks later (1:10+ ratio); we are pre-launch, foundations compound
3. FUNCTIONING CODE — Pragmatic, reliable, wired in per plan
4. CORRECTNESS — Compiles, type-checks, scoped tests pass deterministically
5. CODE QUALITY — Clean code, qualityDimensions satisfied, no warnings
principles: Quality dimensions explicit — qualityDimensions on every task tells you what 'good' looks like
Phase 2 foundation — prefer solutions that lay strong post-launch foundations (1:10+ savings ratio)
Edge cases = test cases — every known edge case must have a corresponding test

Full floor every iteration — every iteration's quality gate is: run `bash bin/gate` (or the project's declared floor command) - the full suite - before the completion commit and paste its `GATE_OK` line as a `Gate:` trailer; a scoped run is a development convenience, never the pre-commit check; REVIEW must leave the trunk green including pre-existing failures
Ship working code with tests to prove it; handle Option/Result explicitly; avoid unwrap() in production

prohibitedOutcomes: Tests that only assert 'no crash' or check type without verifying content
Tests that mirror implementation internals (break when refactoring)
Abstractions with only one concrete use
Error messages that don't identify what went wrong
Catch-all error handlers that swallow context
SystemTime::now() at run_loop entry or beside the stale extra-dir sweep
Absolute stop paths added to format_session_banner
Treating flat task-mgr loop <prd> argv as a live loop-stop target

userStories.description:
Build SignalLocations once per loop and once per batch, and consult stop_requested only at the iteration, wave, and batch-between-PRD boundaries.

DO: Loop canonical is ResolvedPaths.tasks_dir from resolve_paths, captured before startup remaps paths.prd_file onto the worktree copy. Extras, deduped after canonicalize: launch tasks dir (cwd if its final component is tasks, else cwd/tasks); actual_worktree_path/tasks when Some (not slot worktrees); git::main_repo_root_at(source_root)/tasks when Some. After canonicalize, drop a candidate that is missing, whose canonicalize fails, or that equals canonical. A path that is also canonical keeps the no-mtime rule and is not an extra. canonicalize failure does not abort startup. Batch between-PRD canonical is db_dir.join("tasks") (this is .task-mgr/tasks). Batch extras use the same three roots and batch_stop_requested. Capture started_at once with SystemTime::now() before entering run_loop or run_batch (standalone: the loop-run arm in main.rs; batch: the start of run_batch). Store it on LoopRunConfig. run_batch calls engine::run_loop in-process and copies that same SystemTime onto every inner config and every inner SignalLocations. Do not call SystemTime::now() at run_loop entry or next to the sweep. handle_pause deletes the pause file that matched, including an extra-dir copy. On exit, delete only .stop-<prefix> and .pause-<prefix> from each extra. cleanup_signal_files_for_prefix still owns the canonical dir, including its global files. Do not call cleanup_signal_files_for_prefix on an extra. Banner Stop line inside the box is the command task-mgr loop stop --prefix <prefix>. After print_session_banner returns, ui::emit the canonical and extra absolute paths as untruncated stderr lines. Do not add those paths to format_session_banner.
DO NOT: pass SignalLocations into wait_for_usage_reset, wait_for_ask_ttl_inner, transient_backoff_wait, UsageGateFn, ResetWaitFn, or account param structs. Do not add <root>/.task-mgr/tasks as an extra just because it exists. Do not recompute canonical from the remapped prd_file. Do not call git rev-parse yourself; use git::main_repo_root_at(source_root). Do not add a pause check to wave preflight. At loop start, after started_at is captured and the prefix run record is written, delete only this prefix's extra-dir .stop-<prefix> when its mtime is before or equal to that same started_at. ui::emit (not tracing-only) names the absolute path, says it was removed because it predates this process and would have been ignored, and tells the operator to run task-mgr loop stop --prefix <prefix> or create the file again at that same absolute path or at <canonical>/.stop-<prefix>. Do not delete a canonical prefix file, a global .stop, a .pause-<prefix>, or another prefix's stop file in that sweep. A failed delete still warns and does not abort startup. Do not sweep stale extra-dir global files at batch start. Do not delete a global .stop outside the canonical dir on exit. Do not abort an iteration that has already started. The in-progress iteration finishes, then the loop exits 0. Do not conflate operator stop with HorizonStopped. The Pause row inside the box may stay truncated.

Callers affected: iteration.rs step 1, wave_orchestration.rs wave_preflight_check, batch.rs between-PRD check, display.rs print_session_banner call site (not format_session_banner's box), orchestrator.rs step 21, signals.rs handle_pause, LoopRunConfig in engine.rs, the LoopRunConfig literals in main.rs and batch.rs. Account waits are intentionally not callers.

DO: Write {db_dir}/loop-runs/<prefix>.json when a loop starts, before the stale extra-dir prefix sweep, and delete it at orchestrator step 21 after signal cleanup. Record pid, kind, prefix (loop record only), started-at, canonical tasks dir, cwd, worktree, main checkout, and extra tasks dirs. loop stop is a nested LoopCommand::Stop only. It resolves the db dir with resolve_db_dir (same as other subcommands). validate_prefix before joining the prefix into a filename. Do not take LockGuard. Trust a record only when that pid is alive and /proc/<pid>/cmdline, split on NUL, has some element's final path component exactly task-mgr, plus other elements that are the separate tokens loop and run, or batch and run. Not a substring. Not a longer final component. A live prefix record writes .stop-<prefix> in that record's canonical dir and does not write a global .stop. No live prefix record plus a live batch record writes global .stop in the batch record's canonical dir (.task-mgr/tasks). After the write, re-check the pid. If the pid died, unlink only the path this command just wrote. Missing record or rejected pid: non-zero exit, print candidate dirs, create nothing. Add LoopCommand::Stop and handle it in main.rs match resolved. Add .claude/skills/verify-task-mgr/features/loop-stop.md and a README row. The recipe must not invoke loop run or batch run (the helper refuses those). Prove help, missing-record refusal, and invalid-prefix refusal. Report the live-loop path skipped.
DO NOT: take LockGuard. Do not add flat-form flags or grow resolve_loop_command's argument list. Do not write a file relative to the caller's cwd when the record is missing. Do not accept a cmdline whose final component is not exactly task-mgr, or that lacks the separate tokens (task-mgr list, task-mgr loop stop, and deprecated flat task-mgr loop <prd> do not qualify). Do not special-case the flat form into a live target. Do not unlink any stop file other than the path this command wrote. Do not hand-edit the fenced command reference in CLAUDE.md. Early initialize_loop Err paths may leave a prefix run record; overwrite it on the next successful start. Do not add a failure-path deleter for that residual.
